statement_nl: Set up a strong induction on n. For each integer m at least 1, let Alt_m^+ be the alternating sign sequence and define E_0 = 1 and E_m = F(Alt_m^+). The base case n = 2 is immediate: the only sign sequences of length 1 are (+1) and (-1), both are alternating, and each is realized by exactly one permutation, so the theorem holds for n = 2.
